goal: Build independent conventional business applications driven by one shared intelligent runtime, while keeping the group cockpit as the command and observation layer.
current_stage: Enterprise Application Foundation and Intelligent Workflow Integration
next_stage: Deepen Growth & Sales, Manufacturing ERP and Smart Park with domain-specific records, state machines and object-write-back workflows.
product_principles: The cockpit commands and observes; it does not replace operational applications.
Ordinary users work with conventional records, forms, approvals, ledgers, reports, and work queues.
Business objects are authoritative; Agent tasks only advance or analyse them.
All applications share one Kernel, Scheduler, Worker, Runtime, Memory, Approval, and Audit foundation.
Runtime-off applications remain usable; runtime-on applications gain continuous intelligent operation.
Business outcomes must be source-backed and must not be substituted by Agent completion counts.
